name: Maria Jozefa Fan Nasou
original_name: マリア・ヨゼファ=ファン・ナッソウ
source:
Star Sign: Ophiuchus
Image Plant: Casablanca Lily, Lavender

The current Sacred Maiden, an elegant and calm woman. Though she acts like that now when she was just a candidate she was a strong girl with a great sword arm.
Even now, when she gets into battle that old temperament of hers is visible.
She usually lives in a private temple and listens to the candidates worries and acts as a conversation partner to the nobles.
